title: Navy and Arms
author: Pr1nted
$comment: Horn and trumpets over a string ostinato and a forge-like drum bed -- purposeful, martial, not yet violent. Wanted for arming up: ships, ports, fortifications. Driven by the military-buildup signal, which is army plus navy upkeep as a share of income while at peace, so it plays when a country is visibly preparing rather than fighting.
